entry.title: dotnet/efcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-12-04
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • System.InvalidOperationException: 'Unhandled expression '[Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.Query.SqlExpressions.SqlConstantExpression]' #37300
  • Cosmos db complex properties can be configured but are not working. #37297

Closed

  • Entity "views" from IQueryable #37299
  • Allow ignoring Global Query Filters for specific Include navigations #37296
  • How to support multi database providers for data transfering/syncing #37295

PullRequests

Created

  • Fix nullable complex property with PropertyValues.ToObject() creating instance instead of null #37302
  • [release/10.0] Allow tools to run on projects targeting multiple frameworks #37301
  • Add cosmos db complex properties #37298
  • [release/9.0] Fix snapshot generation to capture column type for JSON columns #37294

Updated

  • [release/10.0] Fix snapshot generation to capture column type for JSON columns #37284
  • [release/10.0] Fix NullReferenceException when scaffolding named default constraints #37243
  • [release/10.0] Fix TableSharingConcurrencyTokenConvention to skip JSON-mapped entities #37286
  • [release/10.0] Always generate HasDiscriminator with type argument and property name in snapshot #37242
    Servicing-consider
